about.banner.title: Information
about.intro.title: About Panshaker
about.intro.p1: Panshaker Services is leading the charge in North American restaurant automation. Our mission: bring authentic Eastern flavors across borders so every city can enjoy great food. By pairing industrial-grade automation hardware with our own AI, we deliver kitchens that are reliable, efficient, and built to scale.
about.intro.p2: We pioneered unmanned cooking for Asian restaurants in North America — turning unpredictable kitchen workflows into standardized, repeatable processes. That means lower labor costs, higher efficiency, consistent quality, and simpler operations.
about.intro.p3: Beyond running our own brands, we empower existing restaurants through a store-within-a-store model and equipment subscriptions. Our edge? Self-built wok robots, AI-powered vision monitoring, and PanOS.
about.intro.p4: We're just getting started. From cooking robots to full-stack Asian restaurant infrastructure — we're lowering the barrier for restaurant entrepreneurs everywhere. Cutting-edge tech that bridges the physical and digital worlds, creating value for operators and better experiences for diners.
about.brand.desc: Panshaker Services is the overseas brand of xinchushi

delivery.intro.title: Ingredient Delivery Service
delivery.intro.p1: Panshaker Business Delivery is our ingredient supply service built for Panshaker X7 cooking robot operators. We deliver shredded, diced, and sliced vegetables, marinated meats, and more — every item precisely prepped to match your robot's cooking parameters, so every plate comes out right.
delivery.intro.p2: With a broad supply chain network, we source and customize ingredients for each client's menu. Whether you're serving classic Asian dishes or niche specialty items, we keep costs competitive and your kitchen running smoothly.
delivery.category.title: Ingredient Categories
delivery.category.veg_desc: Fresh vegetables supplied in standardized cuts — shredded, diced, and sliced. Every vegetable is precisely pre-processed to match Panshaker X7 cooking parameters, ensuring consistency and optimal flavor in robotic cooking. From shredded potatoes and diced bell peppers to sliced lotus root and green bean cuts — we cover the full range of vegetable forms your menu demands.
delivery.category.meat_desc: Professionally marinated meats including sliced pork, shredded beef, diced chicken, and more. Each portion is pre-seasoned to recipe standards and optimized for the Panshaker X7's precise temperature control — delivering restaurant-quality consistency on every order.
delivery.category.custom_desc: We have strong supply chain integration capabilities to source and fulfill any specialty ingredient or custom-cut requirement. Whether it's regional specialties, seasonal items, or unique cutting specifications — our sourcing network delivers at competitive prices, giving your menu a real edge.
